text: Learning a new skill is a rewarding journey that requires both practice and patience. You won't become an expert overnight, so it’s important to set realistic goals and give yourself time to improve. Fortunately, there are many resources available today, such as online courses, tutorials, and books, to guide your learning. To stay on track, keep a simple log of your daily or weekly efforts. Seeing your progress, even in small steps, can boost your motivation when you feel stuck. Remember that making mistakes is part of the process. Stay curious, celebrate your wins, and soon you'll look back and be proud of how far you've come.
